title: misleading test name: schema_v1_user_version_is_1 asserts v==7
description: In lib.rs the test at line 800 is named schema_v1_user_version_is_1 but its assertion is assert_eq\!(v, 7, "migration v7 must set user_version to 7"). The function name and the oracle it checks are directly contradictory. A maintainer adding a new V8 migration who searches for 'user_version' tests to update will find this test, read the name, conclude it's testing V1 behavior, and may leave it unchanged — but the assertion will fail because user_version will now be 8. Fix: rename the test to schema_user_version_at_latest or user_version_after_all_migrations and update its assertion comment.
